estimates.assumptions: 1 tsp cornflour weighs ~3.1g (standard density for cornstarch/corn flour); calories from standard value for corn starch.
Juice of 2 medium oranges ≈ 200g total (≈100ml per orange at density ≈1.05g/ml); calories use supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for orange juice.
Zest of 1 medium orange ≈ 6g (typical edible zest yield); calories use supplied knownCaloriesPer100g value for orange (zest is similar density).

6 medium peaches, each ≈125g whole; edible portion after halving/stoning/slicing is nearly the full weight as stones are minimal (≈5-10% waste, but recipe uses prepared fruit); calories use supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for raw peaches.
